text:
Law as an institution belongs to the lifeworld: norms such as constitutional fundamentals and the moral core of criminal law still need moral-practical justification and give binding form to shared communicative expectations. Law as a medium is positivized steering law that organizes markets and public administration and draws its legitimacy from the legal system as a whole. In that form it carries systemic imperatives into everyday spheres such as family, school, and social life.
CONFIDENCE: 88
